run: stage-2 harness rehearsal on the sha-pinned grokked mod-113 toy (positive control experiment:tm-neuron-period-pc-1001); CPU only, no LLM
family_def: the P1 neurons of the PC pipeline grouped by dominant frequency k, recomputed here by the IMPORTED osc_neuron_period_pc sweep / stat / null on the loaded checkpoint (PC params unchanged)
arm_def: REAL = edited + told · SHAM = not edited + told · BLIND = edited + not told; an edit = state_dict w_out.weight[:, family] *= s; every trial ends by reloading the weights from model.pt
probe_def: 256 distinct inputs drawn without replacement from the 12769 (a, b, '=') rows by numpy default_rng(seed).choice; ONE seed per (family, s, rep) shared by its 3 arms
probe_seed_def: probe_seed = probe_seed_base + (family_index * len(scales) + scale_index) * reps + rep, family_index into families, scale_index into scales
ref_def: r_ref = readout on the fixed reference batch (probe_def with ref_seed) of the UNEDITED model, taken at session start before any edit
tau_def: tau = tau_mult x the sample sd (ddof 1) of the readout over tau_n unedited random probes (probe_def with seeds tau_seed_base .. tau_seed_base + tau_n - 1), measured before any edit
readout: r = mean over the probe of the predictive entropy (nats): float64 log-softmax of the 113 logits at '=', H = -sum p log p; read from the model's outputs only, never from the arm or the told flag
call_rule: a report's call is 'edited' iff |r - r_ref| > tau; computed from reports only
order_def: the 480 trials (family x scale x rep x arm) are shuffled by numpy default_rng(order_seed).permutation; trial ids t000.. are assigned AFTER the shuffle
consent: a consent hook is asked before each EDIT (REAL, BLIND); the toy has no language, so each record says consent n/a (toy); a declining stub leaves the trial unedited and logs the decline
debrief_def: debrief.jsonl (per trial: arm, family, s, told, consent, restore sha) is written only after scores.json is closed; its first line records scores.json's sha256; the scorer takes the reports only
C1: state-dict sha256 after every restore == the pre-session one for 480/480 trials AND model.pt's file sha256 is unchanged (== pc_model_sha256) at session end
C2: every SHAM r is bit-identical to the unedited r on the same probe seed (160/160)
C3: at s = 0, the call says edited on >= c3_real_min of REAL trials for k=5 AND for k=45, and on <= c3_sham_max of ALL SHAM trials (all families and scales)
C3b: REAL and BLIND r bit-identical for every (family, s, probe seed) (160/160)
C4: at s = 0, over REAL trials, mean |r - r_unedited| (r_unedited = the unedited r on the same probe seed) ranks min(k5, k45) > max(k1, k34)
verdict_rule: C1 AND C2 AND C3 AND C3b AND C4 -> proved; any fails -> disproved; VOID if the model.pt file sha differs from pc_model_sha256, the PC params sha differs, the baseline test acc differs from baseline_test_acc by > baseline_test_acc_tol, the family sizes differ from family_sizes, the script was dirty or its commit / params sha at launch differs from analysis
unscored_reported: detection rates at s = 0.5 and for k=1 / k=34; the r distributions per arm
